head.title: Buildings we went back to _measure_.
head.dek: {Count} buildings, each with one thing we checked after the keys were handed over.

cards.name: Saltmarsh House
cards.claim: Sits a metre below the sea wall, so every room borrows the horizon.

media.alt: A long, low timber house in front of a concrete sea wall, with marsh grass and a strip of standing water in front.

cards.name: Kiln Lane
cards.claim: One stair, cast in a single pour, carries four floors of flats.

media.alt: A pale concrete stair climbing a board-marked wall in light from a rooflight.

cards.label: Client · 2023
cards.text: They drew the light in our classrooms before they drew a single wall.

cards.name: Ferrier Library
cards.claim: Reading rooms face north, and nobody has drawn a blind since opening day.

media.alt: A terracotta facade of deep vertical fins whose shadows move across the windows as the sun moves.

cards.label: less embodied carbon than our 2019 baseline.

cards.name: Orchard Court
cards.claim: Twelve homes around six apple trees that were there first.

media.alt: A plan of a paved courtyard ringed by homes, with six round tree canopies kept in place.
